caption: The drawing depicts a brown branch with a light tan, diamond-shaped pattern running along its length. Attached to the branch are five green leaves with pronounced, deep lobes and pointed tips, arranged irregularly. The leaves display a solid medium to dark green color, and each has a visible central vein. The background within the border of the drawing is a pale cream shade, and the image is framed by a thin brown line and a wider off-white margin. There is a handwritten label near the top of the inner square area, reading "Winter Oak" in faint green ink.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
